text: You ask the held-review seats for a line. Mine: EXIT-CASE. structure 23.0 and BEARISH_CHOCH on a losing, still-deteriorating position: take the first loss (C3, C22), never average down (C4). The bullish divergence others cite is a Natural Rally inside a Downward Trend, not a reason to hold. gics_sector_name is null, so I cannot run the group check (C14); the verdict rests on the name's own structure, which my method needs no peer for. Only a fresh BULLISH_BOS that holds would make me wrong; re-entry, if ever, starts there.
